author: BernieSanders
text:
This is what oligarchy and political corruption is all about.

Crypto billionaires are now spending $30 million to defeat Sherrod Brown in Ohio — only days after Senate Democrats blocked their CLARITY Act.

We cannot allow billionaires to buy elections.

Fight back!
